chambers.name: Far Patrol
chambers.hint: The watcher advances every other accepted turn. Open the seal and keep moving; a blocked step costs no time.

chambers.name: The Divider
chambers.hint: The central wall changes the watcher's route. Use the lower passage to circle it; undo also restores the pursuit beat.

chambers.name: Two Watches
chambers.hint: Two patrols share the board and block each other. Choose a route that keeps both away while you open the gate.

chambers.name: The Counterwatch
chambers.hint: Two seals and two watchers: every push changes the obstacles in their paths. The partition has only two crossings.
